title: ZEBRA!! — Godot Free Asset Resource Bible
scope: Proposed short game adaptation; not film canon; actual files not acquired

guidance.title: Adaptation scope
guidance.text: Proposed, not part of the film canon: a 30-45 minute linear stylized 3D PC game in Godot 4.x (start with 4.6-compatible stable releases). Keyboard/mouse and Xbox-style gamepad. Third-person chase and short exploration/dialogue rooms; not an open world, shooter simulator, or photorealistic recreation. Use 2D stills for transitions only after clearance.

guidance.title: Art direction
guidance.text: Use IMG-01 as silhouette and palette reference, not as a 3D asset. Low-poly geometry with dark leather-like materials, green emissive code, chrome-looking robots, wet road highlights, warm amber workshop and bar. Keep the joke in the earnest cinematic presentation; do not chase film-level fidelity.

guidance.title: Priority conventions
guidance.text: P0 = needed for a first playable slice; P1 = production polish or secondary scenes; P2 = optional/alternative. Choose one environment kit and one robot pack for the slice; do not ingest every library.

guidance.title: Free vs licensed
guidance.text: All catalog entries have a free access route identified at publisher level, but some are free subsets or donation/name-your-price downloads. CC0 allows modification and commercial use without required credit; MIT code requires copyright/license preservation; CC BY 4.0 music requires attribution and change notices. Sonniss is not CC0: production-use only, no AI training or raw redistribution. Keep license copies and per-file provenance. A free price does not imply public domain.

guidance.title: IP clearance
guidance.text: The treatment and its 63 images are visual development materials, not blanket rights clearance. Use original character and robot designs, original glyphs and posters, original music and voices. Avoid movie actor likenesses, franchise names/logos, ripped models, exact costumes or copied soundtracks. Parody does not automatically authorize every asset. Clear any art intended for shipping, including supplied image references; ask counsel if needed.

guidance.title: Known exclusions
guidance.text: A paid CC0 animal pack that contains both owl and zebra was excluded because checkout requires payment. The exact humanoid owl, adult rideable zebra with matching animations, film-like robot motorcycles, and original hero props were not verified as free ready-to-use assets. Native camera (Camera3D + SpringArm3D + AnimationPlayer) preferred; Phantom Camera repository has an explicit AI/LLM policy, so it is not recommended for an AI-driven workflow without clarification.

guidance.title: Verification boundary
guidance.text: Public publisher pages and licenses were reviewed on 2026-11-19. No third-party archives were downloaded, files inspected, import tested or benchmarked. Counts for free subsets, precise file names and engine compatibility may vary; confirm each package on download. This is a procurement and integration bible, not a shipped asset bundle.

guidance.title: Audio and accessibility
guidance.text: Use AudioStreamPlayer3D for world sound, separate Music/SFX/Dialogue/UI buses, WAV for short effects and Ogg Vorbis for music loops. Normalize with headroom; implement subtitles, volume sliders, reduced camera shake and reduced flashes. Keep dialogue readable, especially during chase.

guidance.title: Import workflow
guidance.text: Download only the free package; save original archive and license outside the Godot project. Prefer GLB/glTF 2.0. Blender can re-export FBX/BLEND as GLB; OBJ cannot carry rig/animation. Import into an isolated test project; check textures, scale, skeleton, loop flags, root motion, collision and material settings. Create inherited/wrapper scenes and external material overrides so reimport does not wipe edits.

guidance.title: Rendering targets
guidance.text: Start desktop Forward+ at 1080p / 60 fps as a target, not a measured guarantee. Use 1K/2K textures, baked/static lighting where viable, limited shadow-casting lights, simple collision, pooled particles and projectiles, MultiMeshInstance3D for repeated street props, LOD and visibility ranges. Use SSR only if budget allows; rain puddles can use reflection probes. Test on lower settings too.

guidance.title: Mounted movement
guidance.text: Zebra is a CharacterBody3D with a collision capsule, AnimationTree or AnimationPlayer; mount point Marker3D or BoneAttachment3D drives Hoot. One motion authority for gameplay, synchronize visual horse stride to speed and blend upper-body rider gestures independently. Add short scripted jumps; do not implement full horse physics. Chase: Path3D with lane offset, deterministic obstacles, checkpoint reset and camera easing.

guidance.title: Scene architecture
guidance.text: Reuse city block and corridor modular scenes. NavigationRegion3D for simple enemies; Area3D for story triggers; PathFollow3D for drone/bike actors; Control nodes for HUD; AnimationPlayer for intro/outro and glass break. Art and behavior separated, each scene assembled from candidate IDs. Use native camera and JSON or Resource-based dialogue initially.

guidance.title: Ingestion ledger
guidance.text: For each actual file, record AS-ID, exact source URL, publisher, downloaded date, version, original archive filename, license text file, sha256, derived paths, changes, assigned G/scene IDs, Godot version, test results and approval. Store raw assets outside repo if not needed; never commit restricted raw audio to a shared repo. Track missing assets and substitutions instead of silently using them.

guidance.title: Build order
guidance.text: Gate A: city street, placeholder rider and horse, one robot, one obstacle, working chase camera and input. Gate B: recognizable Hoot/Zebra, stride sync, robot encounter and glass-break beat. Gate C: Museum, Kevin dialogue and final drawing choice. Gate D: link intro, factory/garden montage, finale and bar; polish audio, performance, credits and accessibility. Finish one 5-minute slice before building all levels.

guidance.title: AI handoff
guidance.text: Use this JSON alongside ZEBRA_complete_treatment.json and ZEBRA_complete_artwork.zip. Do not treat concept_image_ids as downloadable game meshes. Resolve AS IDs against assets; C IDs describe original work. Agent should propose a small acquisition list, ask before accepting restricted EULAs, then fill ingestion ledger and implement one scene at a time. Never replace canonical story or artwork silently.

game_scenes.title: Rocket cold open
game_scenes.adaptation: 1-2 min; on-rails cinematic, no separate flight system.
game_scenes.required_visuals: Rocket silhouette, cape, glass, moon, space backdrop, thought bubble; brief title smash.

game_scenes.title: An ordinary Tuesday / final cinema
game_scenes.adaptation: 3-5 min; walk, inspect, dialogue, scripted ambush.
game_scenes.required_visuals: Apartment, movie screen, theater seats, Director, robot threat, original parody posters.

game_scenes.title: Zebra chase
game_scenes.adaptation: 5-8 min; lane dodge, jump, obstacles, scripted camera shots.
game_scenes.required_visuals: Hoot on Zebra, wet city, red-eyed robots, motorcycles or hover-bikes, drones, billboard faces, explosions.

game_scenes.title: Kevin / Museum of Everything
game_scenes.adaptation: 4-6 min; interact with Kevin, select the child drawing.
game_scenes.required_visuals: Tunnel bench, poet robot, framed originals and repeated paintings, museum corridor, crude drawing.

game_scenes.title: Factory / Garden of Unfinished Things
game_scenes.adaptation: 4-6 min; light puzzle and conversation, optional montage.
game_scenes.required_visuals: Conveyor props, fake emotional backstory terminals, warm workshop, handmade chair and tools.

game_scenes.title: Origin / Curator offer
game_scenes.adaptation: 3-4 min; dialogue and reject/accept prompt (canonical rejection).
game_scenes.required_visuals: Prompt screen, luxury room, wine, books, recurring thought bubble.

game_scenes.title: Final Draft assault / rescue
game_scenes.adaptation: 5-8 min; traverse corridor, evade robots, rescue Zebra, glass breaks.
game_scenes.required_visuals: Tower, bridge chunks, robot squad, drone, Kevin poetry event, shader disruption, breakable glass.

game_scenes.title: Last Original Thought / final confrontation
game_scenes.adaptation: 3-4 min; draw/choose an imperfect zebra and disable optimization.
game_scenes.required_visuals: Wood table, paper, pencil, Curator terminal, imperfect and perfect drawings.

game_scenes.title: Epilogue / rocket / post-credits
game_scenes.adaptation: 2-3 min; bar vignette and in-engine or illustrated end scene.
game_scenes.required_visuals: Bar, drawing, Kevin poetry, rocket, robot terminal and final gag.

custom_asset_requirements.title: Hoot hero
custom_asset_requirements.work: Create owl head, humanoid rig, coat, glasses, feather silhouette, boots and hand/beak sockets; idle, run, mount, lean, drink and cigarette poses.
custom_asset_requirements.acceptance: Export a single rigged GLB with named clips. Recognizable silhouette at gameplay camera; no obvious skinning errors.

custom_asset_requirements.title: Zebra mount
custom_asset_requirements.work: Repaint horse black-and-ivory stripes; custom aviators, reins, saddle and mane. Author gallop if missing; attach Hoot to saddle socket.
custom_asset_requirements.acceptance: Test four gaits, left/right lane change, jump, stop, mounted pose and rescue. No leg sliding at target speed.

custom_asset_requirements.title: Kevin and Curator
custom_asset_requirements.work: Customize original robot mesh, red eyes, chest markings and poetry gestures; Curator uses original abstract face/terminal.
custom_asset_requirements.acceptance: No branded Terminator model or actor likeness; distinctive friendly Kevin silhouette.

custom_asset_requirements.title: Wine, cigarette, rocket
custom_asset_requirements.work: Model lathed wine glass, wine surface, bottle, cylinder cigarette with ember and smoke, red-nosed rocket.
custom_asset_requirements.acceptance: Socket attachments follow animation; scripted glass break, no real-time fluid simulation.

custom_asset_requirements.title: Motorbike and drone
custom_asset_requirements.work: Build simple bike or hover-bike from cylinders and fairing, and drone from hull, arms and rotors.
custom_asset_requirements.acceptance: Script PathFollow3D enemies; use cheap collision proxies, not real vehicle physics.

custom_asset_requirements.title: Digital rain and holograms
custom_asset_requirements.work: Original glyph atlas and scrolling shader on building planes; green code, billboard originals, sparks, rain and glitch transitions.
custom_asset_requirements.acceptance: No copied Matrix symbols/screens or recognizable actor faces. Reduced-motion / flashing toggle.

custom_asset_requirements.title: Museum art and drawing
custom_asset_requirements.work: Create crude child drawing, imperfect zebra and perfect substitute, original sunflower studies and fake posters.
custom_asset_requirements.acceptance: Use original game art or independently cleared public domain files; narrative choice uses distinct texture IDs.

custom_asset_requirements.title: Workshop / archive / bar
custom_asset_requirements.work: Create pencil, paper, picture frames, basic hand tools, bar sign, chair and books if missing.
custom_asset_requirements.acceptance: One reused room kit; warm palette, simple interaction volumes.

custom_asset_requirements.title: Voices, hoofbeats and ambience
custom_asset_requirements.work: Use subtitles first; optionally record original character voices and hoof sounds.
custom_asset_requirements.acceptance: No imitation of identifiable performers without consent. Create captions, different audio buses and volume controls.

custom_asset_requirements.title: Gameplay systems
custom_asset_requirements.work: Native controller, mount sync, chase checkpoints, triggers, projectiles, encounter states, dialogue and final choice.
custom_asset_requirements.acceptance: Assets do not supply a game. Ship functioning prototype before polishing visuals.
